checks.command: python3 -c 'import json,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys; c=pathlib.Path(os.path.expanduser(os.environ.get("THESYSTEM_CLONE","~/theSystem"))); w=pathlib.Path(os.path.expanduser(os.environ.get("THESYSTEM_WORKSPACE","~/workspace"))); p=w/".thesystem/baseline/release.json"; d=json.loads(p.read_text()) if p.is_file() else {}; r=subprocess.run(["git","-C",str(c),"rev-parse","HEAD"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10); head=r.stdout.strip(); ok=r.returncode==0 and bool(head) and d.get("tag")=="master@"+head[:12]; print("OK release and baseline aligned" if ok else "FAIL release and baseline unavailable or differ"); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)'

safe_state.switch: hold the installed theSystem program and baseline unchanged
safe_state.description: Do not run an update or promote a pending baseline automatically; unresolved workspace conflicts and local changes require human review.

sampling.what: Daily local theSystem HEAD and baseline release-tag alignment; emit only aligned/mismatched status.
sampling.working_well: A readable release baseline tag matches the theSystem clone's local HEAD release identifier, or a generic failure is reported without modifying the workspace.

open_decisions: Confirm that the installed program's release identity should be represented by THESYSTEM_CLONE HEAD and that a pending/conflicted update should be reported as drift rather than an expected intermediate state.
